sloka: पिता दानवराजो मे भर्ता मे राक्षसेश्वरः ।पुत्रो मे शक्तनिर्जेता इत्येवं गर्विता भृशम् ।। ६.११४.४० ।।
transliteration: pitā dānavarājo me bhartā me rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।putro me śaktanirjetā ityevaṁ garvitā bhṛśam ।। 6.114.40 ।।

translations.english: "My father is a king of Danavas, my husband is a Lord of Rakshasas, and my son has won over Indra, the Lord of gods, thus I was excessively proud."
